title: 🌐 EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Enters Full Force on 1 January 2026
summary: EU implemented world's first carbon border tax (CBAM) on imports of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilizer, electricity, and hydrogen.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Cross-Border Carbon Pricing & Trade Protectionism. World's 1st carbon border tax operationalized across 6 energy-intensive sectors (steel, aluminium, cement, fertilizer, electricity, hydrogen).
